facts.assertion: Planning Data reports 37,666 records in the Brownfield land dataset.
The Brownfield land dataset reports 354 data providers.
Brownfield land reports collector last ran 23 July 2026 and new data last found 22 July 2026.
Planning Data labels Brownfield land origin as all data from authoritative sources.
Brownfield land is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
Planning Data describes Brownfield site as an experimental dataset of site boundaries found on data.gov.uk and local planning authority websites.
The Brownfield site dataset reports 2,916 records from five providers.
Brownfield site reports collector last ran 26 July 2026 but new data last found 19 December 2025.
Planning Data says Brownfield site data was created by MHCLG and will be replaced with authoritative-source data when available.
The Local plan dataset reports 1,050 local-plan records from 65 providers.
The Local plan dataset reports both collector last ran and new data last found on 24 July 2026.
Planning Data says the Local plan dataset is created by MHCLG and is intended to be replaced with authoritative-source data when available.
Planning Data describes Local plan records as covering current, emerging or historical plans, so plan-stage classification is required before use.
The Development plan status dataset currently reports zero records, zero providers and no collector attempt.
Planning Data's design page records that the Site allocations planning consideration was deprioritised on 17 April 2025 while focus moved to local plans more broadly.
The Site allocations design page currently lists no related dataset for that planning consideration.
The Site allocations design page describes update frequency as ad hoc and notes it would change when a new local plan is adopted.
Planning Data's local-plan specification identifies four required datasets: local plan, local plan boundary, local plan document and local plan timetable.
The local-plan boundary specification expects a single polygon or multipolygon and asks for WGS84 geometry where possible.
Planning Data guidance requires planning-authority publication on an official website, supports CSV/GeoJSON/GML/GeoPackage and requires an Open Government Licence statement.
